description: CHANGES one page of a doc. Either rewrite it whole: markdown as the page should now read, with page_hash (from fetch or write_doc) so nothing written since you read it is lost; if it changed, read again and redo. Or send edits, each an exact old_text found once in the page's Markdown and its new_text. Returns the new hash.

draft.description: The draft key create_boards returned. Pass it on every call about that draft.

edits.description: Changes made in order, instead of markdown

new_text.description: What replaces it; empty removes it

old_text.description: Exactly as in the page's Markdown, found there once

markdown.description: The whole page as it should now read; needs page_hash

page_hash.description: The page's hash when you read it

page_id.description: The page, from fetch or write_doc

title.description: A new title for the page

name: edit_doc_page
title: Edit doc page
